mapper.select:
select su.*, sr.role_name from sys_user as su left join sys_role as sr on su.role_id = sr.role_id
and real_name like concat('%',#{realName},'%')
and student_no like concat('%',#{studentNo},'%')
and status = #{status}
order by create_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into sys_user (real_name, student_no, password, role_id,phone,status, create_time) values (#{realName}, #{studentNo}, #{password}, #{roleId},#{phone},#{status},#{createTime})
